documents.title: MyLINK CORE — Group Strategy Update
documents.excerpt: Ambition of double-digit gross profit growth, led by conversational channels, verification and platform revenue on one consolidated stack.

documents.title: Telenor / Telia A2P termination notice 2026
documents.excerpt: A2P SMS termination increases of 5-7% effective 1 January 2026 in Norway, Sweden and Finland. Contract indexation clauses allow partial pass-through.

documents.title: WhatsApp Business per-message pricing
documents.excerpt: Utility and authentication templates billed per message; marketing template rates revised by market. Bundled conversation packs gain traction.

documents.title: AIT fraud report — Q3 OTP traffic
documents.excerpt: Artificially inflated traffic detected on 9 premium international destinations; ~3% of OTP termination cost non-converting.

documents.title: Least-cost routing model results
documents.excerpt: Direct operator binds undercut hub aggregators by 6-9% on 14 international destinations; estimated NOK 12M annual saving.

documents.title: RCS Business Messaging Nordic launch
documents.excerpt: Nordic operators open RCS to brands; retail pilots show 2.4x engagement vs SMS.

documents.title: Platform consolidation programme
documents.excerpt: Four legacy SMSC platforms from acquired entities to migrate onto MyLINK CORE; data platform decision due end-2026.

documents.title: PSD3 strong customer authentication outlook
documents.excerpt: Stronger authentication requirements expected to lift bank and fintech OTP volumes across EU markets from 2027.
